ic_name: ARM CoreSight On-Chip Debug and Trace Architecture

behavioral_sequences.name: Connect and power up
steps: Debugger drives JTAG/SWD line reset to the Debug Port
Read DPIDR/IDCODE
Set CDBGPWRUPREQ + CSYSPWRUPREQ in CTRL/STAT
Wait for CDBGPWRUPACK + CSYSPWRUPACK
Program SELECT to choose an Access Port

behavioral_sequences.name: Discover components
steps: Read MEM-AP BASE -> top ROM Table
Walk ROM Table entries (relative offsets + present bit)
At each base, read CIDR/PIDR/DEVARCH/DEVTYPE
Build the component inventory

behavioral_sequences.name: Set up a trace session
steps: Unlock (LAR) + claim (CLAIMSET) each component
Program trace source(s): trace ID + enable + filters
Enable funnel input port(s)
Route replicator output(s) to the chosen sink
Configure the sink (TPIU/ETB/ETF/ETR)
Program CTI/CTM channel mappings

behavioral_sequences.name: Capture and decode
steps: Run the target; trace flows on the ATB to the sink
Stop capture; drain ETB/ETF (Debug APB) or read DRAM (ETR)
Demultiplex by ATB trace ID
Reconstruct ETM program flow using the program image

behavioral_sequences.name: Synchronous multi-core halt
steps: A breakpoint on core A raises a CTI trigger on a channel
The CTM broadcasts the channel event to all CTIs
Each CTI drives its core's halt input -> all cores halt
A single restart channel event releases them together

derived_no_calibration_source.literal: no calibration / trim / OTP-cal source in input
derived_no_calibration_source.label: L12 no_calibration auto-set (#634 facet e) — absence-based, mirrors L5.no_analog

power_on_sequence: 1. Power-up: SWD wire-level state may be indeterminate.
2. Host drives ≥ 50 SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=HIGH (line reset).
3. Host issues IDCODE/DPIDR read; target responds ACK=OK + 32-bit DPIDR + parity.
4. Host requests power-up: write CTRL/STAT with CSYSPWRUPREQ=1 + CDBGPWRUPREQ=1; wait for ACKs.
5. Host clears sticky errors via ABORT.
6. Host walks AP IDR catalog: for APSEL=0..255, write SELECT.APSEL then read AP.IDR.
swj_dp_mode_switch_sequence_jtag_to_swd: 3. Shift the 16-bit JTAG-to-SWD selection sequence 0xE79E LSB-first on TMS.
4. Drive ≥ 50 SWCLK cycles with TMS (=SWDIO) = 1 (SWD line reset in new mode).
5. Issue SWD IDCODE/DPIDR read; verify ACK=OK.
swj_dp_mode_switch_sequence_swd_to_jtag: 2. Drive ≥ 50 SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=1 (SWD line reset).
3. Shift the 16-bit SWD-to-JTAG selection sequence 0xE73C LSB-first on SWDIO.
4. Drive ≥ 50 SWCLK cycles with TMS=1 (JTAG TestLogicReset).
5. Issue JTAG IR-scan to verify JTAG TAP responds.
ap_read_sequence_posted: 1. Host writes SELECT with target AP index + bank.
2. Host issues Read AP[N] register X.
3. Target responds ACK=OK + 32-bit data + parity. Data is implementation-defined for first read.
4. Host issues Read AP[N] register Y (or DP.RDBUFF).
5. Target responds ACK=OK + actual data of step 2's read.
6. To recover the last read, host reads DP.RDBUFF.
ap_write_sequence: 1. Host writes SELECT with target AP index + bank.
2. Host issues Write AP[N] register X + 32-bit data + parity.
3. Target responds ACK=OK (or WAIT if busy; FAULT if sticky error).
mem_ap_memory_write_burst_sequence: 1. Host configures CSW: AddrInc=Single, Size=Word, DbgSwEnable=1.
2. Host writes TAR with starting system-bus address.
3. Host issues N successive Write DRW; TAR auto-increments by 4.
4. Host issues final RDBUFF read to flush.
mem_ap_memory_read_burst_sequence: 3. Host issues N successive Read DRW; each returns previous DRW's result; TAR += 4.
4. Host issues final DP.RDBUFF read to recover the last data.
fault_recovery_sequence: 2. Host reads DP.CTRL/STAT to identify STICKYORUN / STICKYCMP / STICKYERR / WDATAERR.
3. Host writes DP.ABORT with corresponding clear bits.
4. Host re-reads CTRL/STAT to confirm cleared.
wait_recovery_sequence: 2. Host advances 1+ SWCLK cycles and retries.
swd_line_reset_recovery_sequence: 4. Host re-writes SELECT (line reset cleared it).
5. Host re-clears sticky bits via ABORT.
multidrop_target_selection_sequence_adiv: 1. Host drives ≥ 50 SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=HIGH (line reset).
3. Host drives another ≥ 50 SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=HIGH.
4. Host issues Write DP.TARGETSEL with the desired target's TPARTNO + TINSTANCE.
5. Only the matching target drives ACK on subsequent transactions.
6. Host issues Read DP.DPIDR to confirm.
cortex_m_halt_sequence_via_swd: 2. Host walks MEM-AP.BASE ROM Table to locate Cortex-M DCB.
3. Host configures MEM-AP: CSW.Size=Word, AddrInc=Off, DbgSwEnable=1.
5. Target halts; host reads DHCSR via DRW; verifies S_HALT=1.
tap_recovery_sequence: Drive SWDIO=HIGH for ≥ 50 SWCLKs → SW-DP line reset.
If stuck in JTAG: TMS=1 for ≥ 5 TCKs → TestLogicReset; then 0xE79E; then SWD line reset.
Assert nTRST=LOW (if available) → SWJ-DP forced to power-on state.
